purpose.zh: 练肩膀往上推的力量，为倒立做准备
purpose.en: Build pushing strength in your shoulders as prep for handstands.

text.zh: 屁股保持高，弯肘让头落到双手前面
text.en: Keep your hips high and bend your elbows to lower your head in front of your hands

text.zh: 身体成倒 V 字，双手与肩同宽，腿伸直。
text.en: Make an upside-down V with hands shoulder-width apart and legs straight.

text.zh: 手肘斜着往后弯，再撑回手臂伸直。
text.en: Bend your elbows back at an angle, then push back to straight arms.

commonErrors.zh: 屁股掉下来变成普通俯卧撑
commonErrors.en: Dropping the hips into a regular push-up.

cautions.zh: 手腕刺痛或发麻时停止，开始前先活动手腕
cautions.en: Stop if your wrists feel sharp pain or numbness, and warm them up first.
If your shoulders hurt, go less deep.

changes: peak 口令「底部」改动词「停一下」；end「推起」改「撑起」
节奏核对：动画顶点真正静止约 0.37 秒（<0.8），rep_hold 改为 rep_updown
flags: 派生把顶点算成 ≥0.8 s 判为 rep_hold，但 spec 轨道真正的静止只有约 0.3–0.4 s（注释/关键帧），若按实际应为 rep_updown，请确认
